description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 1 came out on 17 January 2025, as the Chinese game moved to the Scarlet & Violet series, to give collectors a new way to collect. Every card is a holo, four to a pack, and Gem Packs have their own rarity marks: ●, ◆, ★, ★★ and ★★★. Each pack holds three ● or ◆ cards and one with stars.

Volume 1 has 16 Pokémon: the Paldea starters Sprigatito, Fuecoco and Quaxly with Floragato, Crocalor and Quaxwell, Captain Pikachu, Vulpix, Pawmo, Fidough, Sudowoodo, Rockruff, Paldean Wooper, Maschiff, Chansey and Lechonk. Each comes in several versions: the same art with a pattern of its Energy symbol, of Poké Balls and other finishes, and with luck a Master Ball pattern, a gold-foil Gem Pack logo, art of the shiny Pokémon, or new art showing a trainer from the Pokémon anime with the Pokémon. It also has holo Poké Ball, Great Ball, Ultra Ball and Nemona cards and basic Grass, Fire and Water Energy. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon (17 for Trainers and 18 for Energy) and the last two for the version, so Sprigatito runs from 0101 to 0109. From launch day, buying 30 packs or two boxes of 15 packs earned a bonus card while 250,000 lasted.
